Definition: to murmur (in pleasure or anger); by implication, to ponder
BiblicalUsage: 1) to moan, growl, utter, muse, mutter, meditate, devise, plot, speak; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to roar, growl, groan; 1a2) to utter, speak; 1a3) to meditate, devise, muse, imagine; 1b) (Poal) to utter; 1c) (Hiphil) to mutter
